# GNOME and Adwaita icons in Toddy design concepts

Unmodified SVG source artwork is included for realistic, offline UI studies.
These files are third-party works, not original Toddy OS artwork. Their upstream
terms remain in force; the project's MIT/CC BY 4.0 grants do not replace them.
No GNOME endorsement, installed application or target OS support is implied.

- Adwaita folders and symbolic icons: GNOME Project, adwaita-icon-theme 50.0-1,
  installed trusted distribution package; see ADWAITA-COPYRIGHT.txt.
- Files app icon: GNOME Design Team, nautilus package 1:50.2.2-0ubuntu0.2;
  embedded SVG metadata grants CC BY-SA 4.0. Full package notice retained.
- Settings app icon: gnome-control-center 1:50.3-0ubuntu0.2; package notice and
  GPL texts retained. Do not infer a permissive art license from visual appearance.
- Console and Web app icons: official GNOME GitHub mirrors, exact commits and
  hashes in manifest.json; upstream COPYING texts retained.

[manifest.json](manifest.json) records source URL, exact package/commit, SHA-256
and license qualification for every SVG. All files remain unmodified; CSS sizes
them and sets symbolic foreground contrast. Source SVGs and notices are exported
with the public preview for attribution, license and corresponding source access.
Screenshots containing these icons retain the third-party artwork qualifications;
do not claim they consist exclusively of CC BY 4.0 original Toddy material.

Attribution: [GNOME Project](https://www.gnome.org/), GNOME Design Team and the
upstream authors named in the retained notices. The Web icon represents a browser
in a design study; final default browser selection remains subject to the plan.
